items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Because Duke Ellyn was playing nice sweet stuff and things and they kidded him.

ctx.x: But one thing I will say, I don't know, the Chicago people when I first got there, they liked it more blues numbers like. Because Duke Ellyn was playing nice sweet stuff and things and they kidded him. But when Louis went there with all that jumping and clowning and all kind of felt like me, you know, and the other people went for that, crazy about that. But later on they got to going for that nice music, you know. Later on, yeah, they got to going for that classic stuff. Later on.
Do they have more shows in Chicago than here, or more here?
